messages:
Jordyn: Heads-up — we'll start the api-v3 deploy in prod at :30m from now. Feature flag 'api_v3_enabled' will be rolled out as follows: 1% -> 10% after 10m -> 50% after healthy 30m -> 100% after 2h. Pin note: rolling binary will be pinned to build-2026.03.12.

Ken: Ack. Can you post the health gates and rollback triggers here pls?

Jordyn: Sure — core gates: error-rate delta <= +1.5% relative to baseline (5m window), p50 latency <= +80ms, 95th <= +250ms. If any gate trips for 3 consecutive checks (5m cadence) we cut the cohort back to previous flag state. Fast rollback trigger: sustained 2%+ error rate for 3m.

Ruth: tagging @SRE-Oncall to watch infra metrics and queue depth during the 10 -> 50 shift. Also note this touches session cache keys, so watch cache hit ratio.

SRE-Oncall: On it. I'll attach an adhoc dashboard and set an alert to page if error_rate > 2% for 3m or req_queue_length > 1000.

Maya-Product: small ask from product: if we hit a minor perf blip but no errors, hold at 10% until we can validate qualitative outputs (we have a quick eval set). Prefer manual advance in that case.

Jordyn: noted — switch to manual advance on perf-only signals. Auto-advance stays for error-free health.

Ken: Can you paste the flag patch config you'll apply?

Jordyn: Pushing flag via launchpad CLI. Config snippet: 
```
flag: api_v3_enabled
mode: gradual
steps:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 10m
  - pct: 10
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 50
    duration: 120m
  - pct: 100
rollout_pin: build-2026.03.12
rollback_policy:
  error_rate_threshold_pct: 2.0
  sustained_minutes: 3
  checks_window: 5m
```

Deploy-Bot: deploy queued by Jordyn for api-v3 @ 1739458200. CI artifacts: build-2026.03.12. Estimated ETA to 100% (if healthy): ~2h30m.

Deploy-Bot: Preflight checks: integration-tests ✅, schema-migration ✅, infra-quota ✅, smoke (staging) ☑️.

SRE-Oncall: I've added short-lived dashboards: /dashboards/api-v3-rollout and set page rules. Also enabling debug log sampling at 5% for api-service to get traces without high noise.

Jordyn: Kicking off now. Advancing to 1%. Will update on each step.

Deploy-Bot: Rollout started: api_v3_enabled -> 1% (hosts: canary-01..03).

Ken: seeing slight bump in p95 on canary-02, +60ms. No errors. Holding at 1% as per manual hold rule for perf blips.

Jordyn: Holding — thanks. SRE, please dig into canary-02 logs for slow DB calls.

SRE-Oncall: Found a slow query on session-lookup when cache miss spikes. Root cause looks like a new query plan; patch queued to adjust index usage. Will monitor.

Ruth: Product evals look fine for 1% users. No regressions in responses.

Jordyn: Can we safely continue to 10% in ~20m after the query patch lands?

SRE-Oncall: Patch rolled to canary-02. Observing 12m — p95 back to baseline. If stable for next 10m we can advance.

Maya-Product: approve advancing once p95 stable.

Deploy-Bot: Manual advance requested by Jordyn to 10%. Proceed when SRE confirms.

SRE-Oncall: Confirmed. Advance now.

Deploy-Bot: Rollout updated: api_v3_enabled -> 10% (hosts: canary-01..08).

Jordyn: Monitoring the 10% cohort. Watch for error spike or queue buildup.

SRE-Oncall: No errors, CPU and queue stable. p50 +30ms, p95 +45ms. Good to hold for 30m for qual checks.

Jordyn: Product is running quick eval set. If green after 30m we plan auto-continue to 50%. If any manual stop requested, we'll pause and revert to previous flag state.

(20m later)

Maya-Product: evals are green. small quality improvement on fallback cases. Authorizing continue.

Deploy-Bot: Auto-advancing to 50% per rollout rules.

Deploy-Bot: Rollout updated: api_v3_enabled -> 50% (hosts: prod-frontpool-1..12).

Ken: hitting a small uptick in DB tail latency on shard 3, not full errors. SRE-Oncall looking.

SRE-Oncall: Injected a temporary connection pool increase to shard-3; tail latency normalized. No errors.

Jordyn: Good. Continuing to monitor. If any gate trips, rollback policy: immediate cutback to 10% + create hotfix branch.

(1h30m later)

Deploy-Bot: Rollout progressed to 100%.

Jordyn: Deploy complete. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/notes/api-v3-release-2026-03-12. Please file any postmortems if you saw anomalies.

Maya-Product: quick note — flag will stay unpinned after 24h so we can toggle for experiments. If anyone needs it pinned longer ping me. :rocket:

Ken: Thanks team. Clean rollout, nice coordination.

Ruth: Leaving a follow-up item: add a preflight check for cache plan differences between canaries and prod to catch query-plan regressions earlier.

Jordyn: Filed a ticket: INF-9421. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
